info.description: The Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD) provides comprehensive integrated biological information for the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae along with search and analysis tools to explore these data, enabling the discovery of functional relationships between sequence and gene products in fungi and higher organisms.

post.summary: map gene identifiers to current SGD genes
post.description: Resolves a list of identifiers (systematic or standard gene names, aliases, protein names such as Act1p, SGDIDs with or without the SGD: prefix, UniProtKB accessions, NCBI Gene IDs, RefSeq protein/nucleotide IDs, retired names, and names of merged genes) to current SGD loci. Each input is reported as matched, ambiguous, retired or not_found. At most 5000 identifiers.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: identifiers as a list, or a single string separated by whitespace, commas or semicolons

200.description: resolution of each identifier

400.description: missing identifiers or more than 5000 identifiers

post.summary: enrichment of a gene list in regulators, phenotypes, complexes, pathways, domains, diseases and GO
post.description: Hypergeometric test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR. For each category the default background is all genes with at least one annotation in that category; a custom background may be supplied. GO categories (go_process, go_function, go_component) are computed by GO Term Finder with its own background and corrected p-values, and are not run unless requested.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: pass either genes (any identifiers accepted by /gene_list/resolve) or bioent_ids

categories.description: default: regulator, phenotype, complex, pathway, domain, disease

min_overlap.description: minimum number of list genes annotated to a term

200.description: significant terms per category

400.description: no genes, unknown category, or invalid parameters

get.summary: categories available to /gene_list/enrichment

200.description: list of categories

post.summary: download one type of SGD annotation for a gene list
post.description: Returns one data type for up to 5000 genes, as JSON {columns, rows} or, with "format": "tsv", as a tab-separated file. Where SGD publishes a genome-wide download file for the data type (phenotype_data.tab, interaction_data.tab, posttranslational_modifications.tab, protein_properties.tab, gene_literature.tab, regulation and disease files) the columns are the same. At most 200,000 rows are returned per request (truncated=true beyond that). GET /gene_list/annotation_types lists the columns of each type.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: pass either genes (any identifiers accepted by /gene_list/resolve) or bioent_ids

interaction_scope.description: interaction only: "within" keeps interactions between list genes

homolog_species.description: homolog only: restrict to these species

200.description: the annotation rows

400.description: unknown data_type, no genes, or invalid options

get.summary: data types available to /gene_list/annotations, with their columns

200.description: list of data types

source_file.description: SGD download file with the same columns, if any

post.summary: expression heatmap data (log2 ratios) for a gene list
post.description: log2 expression ratios for up to 100 genes across the samples of the datasets where the genes respond most (excess per-gene standard deviation over the dataset's typical gene; datasets of up to 60 samples, at most 400 columns) or of one chosen dataset, with all datasets ranked for the list, a category per dataset (from its keywords) and average-linkage clustering orders (1 - Pearson) for genes and samples.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: pass either genes (any identifiers accepted by /gene_list/resolve) or bioent_ids

dataset_id.description: show this dataset instead of the top-ranked ones

200.description: heatmap data

400.description: no genes, unknown dataset_id, or invalid options

post.description: Genes of the list and the edges between them: physical and genetic interactions (BioGRID; one edge per gene pair with the number of records and references), regulation (regulator -> target), co-expression (one gene among the other's top co-expressed genes; lists of up to 500 genes) and shared GO annotations (manually curated or high-throughput annotations to GO terms with at most 100 genes). Optionally adds the genes outside the list that connect the most list genes. Networks over max_edges are cut by raising the evidence threshold, then keeping the strongest edges of each type; notes say what was left out.

bioent_ids.description: locus dbentity ids (as returned by /gene_list/resolve), at most 5000

genes.description: gene identifiers, resolved like /gene_list/resolve (instead of bioent_ids)

min_evidence.description: minimum records per interaction / regulation edge; default 1 for lists under 100 genes, else 2

neighbors.description: add up to this many genes outside the list that connect at least 2 list genes (0-100, default 0)

go_min_shared.description: shared GO terms needed for a shared_go edge (default 2)

example.genes: PET9 TIM22 COX12 MIX17 ISU1 ISU2

200.description: nodes (id, name, systematic_name, link, description, in_list, degree), edges (type, source, target, weight and type-specific evidence), edge_types, list_size, neighbors_added, min_evidence, min_evidence_used, total_edges, shown_edges, edge_counts, notes

get.summary: GO term suggestions for building a gene list
get.description: Search GO term names (at least 3 characters) or look up a GO ID. Exact matches come first, then names starting with the query, then other names containing it, shorter names first. Only terms with annotations to the term or a descendant are returned (at most 20).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: term name text or GO ID, e.g. trehalose or GO:0005991

200.description: {terms: [{id, display_name, namespace, link}]}

get.summary: genes annotated to a GO term, for a gene list
get.description: Current SGD genes annotated to a GO term and, by default, its descendant terms (is a, part of and regulates relations, as on the GO term pages). NOT annotations are left out.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: GO ID or exact term name, e.g. GO:0005991

parameters.name: include_descendants
parameters.description: include genes annotated to descendant terms (default true)

parameters.name: annotation_type
parameters.description: repeat to allow several types (default: all three)

200.description: the term, options and genes; also annotation_types

term.description: id, display_name, link (and namespace for GO)

term_count.description: number of terms included (the term plus descendants)

genes.description: loci as in /gene_list/resolve: id, sgdid, systematic_name, gene_name, display_name, qualifier, description, link

400.description: unknown term, unknown option, or the term covers more than 5000 genes (JSON {error})

get.summary: phenotype (observable) terms for building a gene list
get.description: The Yeast Phenotype Ontology observable tree, depth first and sorted by name, with the number of genes annotated to each term or its descendants (excluding "normal" results), and the phenotype qualifiers in use.

200.description: {terms: [{id, display_name, link, depth, gene_count}], qualifiers: [string]}

get.summary: genes with a phenotype, for a gene list
get.description: Current SGD genes annotated to a phenotype observable and, by default, its descendant terms. Results with a "normal" qualifier (no phenotype observed) are left out unless include_normal is set or that qualifier is requested; annotations without a qualifier are kept.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: APO ID or exact observable name, e.g. APO:0000199 or chitin deposition

parameters.name: include_descendants
parameters.description: include genes annotated to descendant terms (default true)

parameters.name: qualifier
parameters.description: only this qualifier, e.g. decreased

parameters.name: include_normal
parameters.description: include "normal" results (default false)

200.description: the term, options and genes; also qualifier and include_normal

term.description: id, display_name, link (and namespace for GO)

term_count.description: number of terms included (the term plus descendants)

genes.description: loci as in /gene_list/resolve: id, sgdid, systematic_name, gene_name, display_name, qualifier, description, link

400.description: unknown term, unknown option, or the term covers more than 5000 genes (JSON {error})

get.summary: term suggestions for building a gene list from a disease, regulator, complex, pathway or domain
get.description: Terms of the category whose name contains the query (or whose DOID / InterPro ID matches it), exact matches first, with the number of genes (for disease including descendant terms). At most 20.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: at least 2 characters, e.g. myopathy, GCN4, proteasome, IPR001611

200.description: the term, options and genes; also qualifier and include_normal

term.description: id, display_name, link (and namespace for GO)

term_count.description: number of terms included (the term plus descendants)

genes.description: loci as in /gene_list/resolve: id, sgdid, systematic_name, gene_name, display_name, qualifier, description, link

400.description: unknown term, unknown option, or the term covers more than 5000 genes (JSON {error})

get.summary: genes of a disease, regulator, complex, pathway or domain, for a gene list
get.description: Current SGD genes for one term: genes associated with a human disease (by default including descendant terms; NOT annotations left out), targets of a transcriptional regulator, subunits of a complex, genes of a pathway or proteins with an InterPro domain. Apart from disease these are the gene sets the enrichment tests use.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: disease (Disease Ontology), regulator (targets of a transcriptional regulator), complex (subunits), pathway (YeastPathways) or domain (InterPro)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: term name, DOID or InterPro ID, or the key returned by category_terms, e.g. DOID:699, GCN4, IPR001611

parameters.name: include_descendants
parameters.description: disease only: include genes annotated to descendant terms (default true)

200.description: the term, options and genes; also qualifier and include_normal

term.description: id, display_name, link (and namespace for GO)

term_count.description: number of terms included (the term plus descendants)

genes.description: loci as in /gene_list/resolve: id, sgdid, systematic_name, gene_name, display_name, qualifier, description, link

400.description: unknown term, unknown option, or the term covers more than 5000 genes (JSON {error})
